info.title: API.SH: WooCommerce
info.description: The WooCommerce API from API.SH: public WooCommerce data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every product category of a WooCommerce shop: id, name, slug, parent, description, product and review counts, image and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-categories

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: The shop's domain (any WooCommerce shop with its public Store API), e.g. porterandyork.com.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

categories.name: Subscriptions
categories.description: The parent category for all new subscription products.

get.description:
The filters a WooCommerce shop offers, with counts: price range, products per stock status and star rating, every attribute with its terms, tags and brands. Optionally for one category or search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-filters

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: The shop's domain (any WooCommerce shop with its public Store API), e.g. porterandyork.com.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids or slugs, comma separated.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product of any WooCommerce shop from its page link (or shop + id or slug): everything the search gives plus each variation's own name, SKU, price, sale price, stock status, low-stock count, image and weight.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page link.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: The shop's domain, with id or slug instead of url.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id (with store).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Product slug (with store).

parameters.name: variations
parameters.description: false to leave out the variation details (default true).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products of any WooCommerce shop with every filter its Store API takes: words, category, tag, brand, attribute terms, price range, on sale, featured, stock status, star rating, product type, SKU and ids, and every sort. Each product has its name, link, type, SKU, price, regular and sale price, price range, currency, discount, rating, review count, stock status and low-stock count, short and full description, images, categories, tags, brands, attributes with terms, variation ids, weight and dimensions. `total` and `total_pages` come from the shop.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-products

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: The shop's domain (any WooCommerce shop with its public Store API), e.g. porterandyork.com.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids or slugs, comma separated (see /woocommerce/v1/categories).

parameters.name: category_operator
parameters.description: How several categories combine: in (default), not_in or and.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag ids or slugs, comma separated (see /woocommerce/v1/filters).

parameters.name: tag_operator
parameters.description: in, not_in or and.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand ids or slugs, comma separated, on shops that use brands.

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description: Attribute filters as taxonomy:term,term; separated by semicolons, e.g. pa_color:red,blue;pa_size:large (terms by slug or id; see /woocommerce/v1/filters).

parameters.name: attribute_relation
parameters.description: and (default) or or between attribute filters.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true for products on sale only.

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: true for featured products only.

parameters.name: stock_status
parameters.description: instock, outofstock or onbackorder, comma separated.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Average star ratings to include (1-5), comma separated.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Product type.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: SKUs, comma separated.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Product ids, comma separated.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 24).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Product reviews of a WooCommerce shop, for one product, one category or the whole shop: rating, text, date, verified-buyer flag, reviewer name and avatar, and the product reviewed. Sort by date or rating.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-reviews

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: The shop's domain (or give a product url).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page link, for that product's reviews.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Product ids, comma separated.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Category ids, comma separated.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-100 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A WooCommerce shop's product tags: id, name, slug, description, product count and tag page link, with the total. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-tags

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Shop domain or any link on the shop.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only tags matching these words.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: count (most products first, default), name or slug.

parameters.name: hide_empty
parameters.description: 1 = leave out tags with no products.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Tags per page (default 100, max 100).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every variation of a variable product in a WooCommerce shop, paged: id, attribute values, name, SKU, link, price, regular and sale price, currency, sale flag, stock (in stock, backorder, low stock count, stock text), images, weight, dimensions, description and quantity limits; plus the product's variation attributes with their terms. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woocommerce-variations

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page link on the shop.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Shop domain (with id or slug instead of url).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric product id (with store).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Product slug (with store).

parameters.name: stock_status
parameters.description: Only variations with this stock status.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Shop order (default) or price, low to high.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Variations per page (default 50, max 100).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
